# dns_soa_record_set (Data Source)

Use this data source to get the SOA record of a DNS zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dns_soa_record_set" "example" {
  zone = "example.com."
}

output "mname" {
  value = data.dns_soa_record_set.example.mname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Zone to look up, must be an FQDN ending with a dot.

### Read-Only

- `expire` (Number) The expire time in seconds.
- `id` (String) Always set to the zone.
- `mname` (String) The primary master name for the zone.
- `refresh` (Number) The refresh interval in seconds.
- `retry` (Number) The retry interval in seconds.
- `rname` (String) The email address of the administrator responsible for the zone.
- `serial` (Number) The serial number of the zone.
- `ttl` (Number) The TTL of the record.
